input: 13 physical AGRI C01-C06/C09-C15 + cosSOZ + cosRAA + day_mask; 16x16 patch
normalization: checkpoint metadata.norm; fitted on train only; normalized nonfinite inputs imputed with zero
forecast_AGRI_input: invert SimVP normalization to physical AGRI first, then apply this R normalization
architecture: COTUNet in scripts/train_cot_repaired.py; base16 two-level U-Net
explicit_features: mean, population std, p90, center pixel of R output; center convention to be fixed before downstream cache
latent_features: same frozen R forward_features, spatial mean then fixed 4D projection; seeds11/22/33 per plan
scope: real AGRI retrieval-reference validation; forecast-domain and GHI improvement not yet tested
